systems.name: RigidBodySys
systems.summary: Creates the Jolt bodies of new RigidBody, Ground and HeightField components and destroys them when the component or entity goes away.

systems.name: TerrainCollidersSys
systems.summary: Builds static marching-cubes MeshShape colliders around the host's dynamic bodies before this frame's physics steps, prefetches cells on their path.

systems.name: WorldTerrainSys
systems.summary: Per-world marching-cubes ground: builds TerrainColliders cells inline around every dynamic body before the world's PhysicsStep.

systems.name: PhysicsSys
systems.summary: Host Jolt step: fixed 60 Hz accumulator (FixedStepClock), kinematic bodies follow Transforms, dynamic Transforms interpolated from PhysicsPose, fallen entities destroyed.

systems.name: PhysicsStepSys
systems.summary: One fixed tick of a world: kinematic targets, PhysicsConfig::substeps Jolt updates of h / substeps, then PhysicsPose and Transform of dynamic bodies.

systems.name: PolicySys
systems.summary: Runs the world's PolicyHandle ONNX policy on AgentIO::observation and writes AgentIO::action for the decision window.

systems.name: ModelWatcherSys
systems.summary: Viewer host system: loads ONNX policies (fixed files or the newest checkpoint of a directory, hot-reloaded) and injects them as PolicyHandle into each world, reporting in PolicySources.

components.name: PhysicsPose
components.summary: The last two simulated poses of a dynamic Jolt body.
components.description: Emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by RigidBodySys on every entity whose RigidBody is Motion::Dynamic, right after its Jolt body is created, with both poses set to the Transform's position and rotation. PhysicsSys (host) and PhysicsStepSys (worlds) shift position/rotation into prev_* and read the new pose from Jolt after each step. PhysicsSys then writes Transform = mix/slerp(prev, current, alpha) for every Transform + PhysicsPose entity; PhysicsStepSys writes Transform = current. Viewers (WorldView, SphereView, roller players) interpolate world bodies between prev and current. World-space metres and unit quaternions. It is NOT removed when the RigidBody is removed (only when the entity is destroyed); on the host a leftover PhysicsPose keeps overriding the Transform with the frozen last pose. Not registered in the scene component registry.

fields.desc: Body position after the step before the last one, world metres.

fields.name: position
fields.desc: Body position after the last step, world metres.

fields.name: prev_rotation
fields.desc: Body rotation after the step before the last one.

fields.name: rotation
fields.desc: Body rotation after the last step.

components.name: FixedStepClock
components.summary: Host fixed-step accumulator shared by TerrainCollidersSys (looks ahead at this frame's steps) and PhysicsSys (takes them).
components.description: Created on demand (find-or-emplace) by PhysicsSys::preinit or the first TerrainCollidersSys tick. fixed_dt = 1/60 s, at most max_steps = 4 steps per frame. stepsFor(dt) = min(floor((accumulator + min(dt, 0.25)) / fixed_dt), 4) and is const, so TerrainCollidersSys and PhysicsSys compute the same step count in one frame as long as TerrainColliders runs first. PhysicsSys adds min(dt, 0.25) to accumulator, subtracts steps * fixed_dt after stepping and resets accumulator to 0 when it still exceeds fixed_dt (slow frames drop simulation time). sim_time advances by fixed_dt per step and is the time base of the host's TerrainColliders eviction. World registries do not use it (they use WorldClock).

fields.name: fixed_dt
fields.desc: Step length, seconds.

fields.name: max_steps
fields.desc: Maximum steps per frame.

fields.name: accumulator
fields.desc: Unsimulated frame time, seconds; accumulator / fixed_dt is the interpolation alpha.

fields.name: sim_time
fields.desc: Simulated time, seconds (steps * fixed_dt).

components.name: PhysicsWorld
components.summary: A Jolt PhysicsSystem with its job system and temp allocator, one per registry.
components.description: World registries get it in the World constructor from the template's "physics" block (PhysicsConfig via physicsConfig(def)). The host registry gets the default PhysicsConfig the first time physicsWorld(reg) is called (preinit of RigidBodySys / TerrainCollidersSys / PhysicsSys / PhysicsStepSys / WorldTerrainSys). Requires a live JoltRuntime (logs critical otherwise). threads == 1 uses JobSystemSingleThreaded; otherwise a JobSystemThreadPool of `threads` threads, or hardware_concurrency/2 - 1 (min 1) when threads == 0. Object layers: static(0), moving(1), agent(2), sensor(3); static collides with moving and agent, moving with everything, agent with sensor; broad phase non_moving (static layer) and moving (everything else). step(dt) calls PhysicsSystem::Update(dt, 1 collision step). Query helpers groundBelow / castStatic / sphereContact only hit the static layer and use the NoLock interfaces (outside the step only). Friction/restitution combine rules Geometric (Jolt default), Max or Min. Non-copyable.
components.scene_json: world template "physics": { threads, max_bodies, max_body_pairs, max_contacts, temp_bytes, gravity, substeps, allow_sleeping, friction_combine, restitution_combine, velocity_steps, position_steps, speculative_distance, penetration_slop } (parsed by physicsConfig in src/scene/world.cpp)

components.name: std::shared_ptr<TerrainColliders>
components.summary: The world's marching-cubes collider cache, shared by WorldTerrainSys so agents can query or require ground cells.
components.description: Emplaced by WorldTerrainSys::preinit (the same object it updates every fixed tick). TerrainColliders cuts space into cells of 16^3 marching cubes (64 world units with chunk::cube_size 4); required cells are meshed on the CPU (density from a loaded ChunkVolume via ChunkMap, else TerrainGenerator::sample) and added as static MeshShape bodies (friction 0.8, static layer) in sorted (x, y, z) order; idle cells are evicted after 5 s of the caller's time. Other code (sphere roller spawn) calls require(bounds, time) and surfaceHeight / overhangAmplitude. The host's TerrainCollidersSys owns its own TerrainColliders as a unique_ptr, not in the context.

fields.name: cell_cubes
fields.desc: Marching cubes per cell side.

fields.name: cell_size
fields.desc: World units per cell side (cell_cubes * chunk::cube_size).

fields.name: eviction_delay
fields.desc: Seconds without a body nearby before a cell is evicted.

fields.name: cells
fields.desc: Cell state (Building, Built, Active, Empty), pending job, Jolt body, triangles, last_used.

fields.name: triangle_count
fields.desc: Triangles of active cells.

fields.name: generator
fields.default: the registry's std::shared_ptr<TerrainGenerator> at construction, else a default TerrainGenerator
fields.desc: Density source.

fields.name: marching_cubes
fields.desc: CPU mesher.

components.name: PolicyHandle
components.summary: The ONNX policy a world's PolicySys runs.
components.description: Inserted (insert_or_assign) into a world registry by ModelWatcherSys on the host, or by tests. Replacing it swaps the policy at the next Act tick. Worlds with the same ModelWatcher spec share one PolicyRunner; PolicyRunner::run is called concurrently from parallel worlds (Ort::Session::Run is thread-safe). A null runner or a missing handle makes PolicySys do nothing.

fields.name: runner
fields.desc: Loaded, layout-validated ONNX Runtime session.

fields.name: deterministic
fields.desc: true: output deterministic_continuous_actions (mean); false: continuous_actions (mean + noise).

components.name: PolicySources
components.summary: What each world's policy is, for panels and overlays.
components.description: Emplaced by the ModelWatcherSys constructor; filled on its first tick (one PolicySource per world, in world index order) and updated on every load or load failure. Read by SphereView's panel. PolicySource fields: spec (the model parameter string), file (loaded checkpoint path, empty before the first load), step (from <behavior>-<step>.onnx, -1 when the name has none), error (last load error, cleared on success).

fields.name: worlds
fields.desc: Indexed by world index; find(world) returns nullptr out of range.
